practical: Review of INS error diagrams and drift vectors; Instructor supervision required for diagram interpretation.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of an Inertial Navigation System?
Define the term 'drift' in the context of gyroscopes.
List three sources of error in an INS system.

development.content:
Initial leveling error definition
Initial tilt error causes
Accelerometer bias errors
Integrator error accumulation
Initial azimuth misalignment

Azimuth gyro drift characteristics
Leveling gyro drift mechanisms
Error correction techniques
Impact on navigation accuracy
Mitigation strategies

Systematic vs random errors
Environmental error factors
Calibration procedures
Maintenance impact on errors
Operational limitations

summary_questions: Explain how initial tilt error affects the calculated position.
Describe the relationship between azimuth gyro drift and heading accuracy.
Identify two methods to minimize integrator error in INS systems.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how Mixed inertial systems and velocity damping address the errors discussed in this lesson, linking to the next lesson on Mixed inertial systems.

pft_rows.syllabus: Mixed inertial system, velocity damped inertial system, damping by Doppler velocity. Fix monitored inertial systems, stellar monitored inertial system.
